races.name: Jumps Look Better On Racing TV Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
THEY'RE CHANCERS has been an infrequent visitor to the track but has looked promising when we have seen him and his pedigree points to this longer trip being within range. Hexham scorer Finisk Pride may give him most to think about.

  1. THEY'RE CHANCERS (IRE)
  2. FINISK PRIDE (IRE)
  3. WHISKEY ON ICE (IRE)

races.name: Graeme Todd Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div 1)
races.verdict:
Lots of these arrive with a question mark against them and it could pay to side with the lightly-raced KING HORSE taking a sizeable step forward now with Nicky Richards and capitalising on a lenient-looking mark. Tigress Lilly arrives in top form and rates a big danger though, while handicap debutant Old Comrades can also play a prominent role.

  1. KING HORSE (FR)
  2. TIGRESS LILLY
  3. OLD COMRADES (IRE)

races.name: Graeme Todd Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Lots with chances but LESTER MAIL rates just the pick of the weights and is taken to build on a recent Hexham third after an absence and add to his bumper success here. Valtteri Its James heads the dangers, although a market move for Annual Invitation could prove significant.

  1. LESTER MAIL (FR)
  2. VALTTERI ITS JAMES (IRE)
  3. ANNUAL INVITATION (IRE)

races.name: Everything Kverneland Think Paxtons' David Edgar Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Stablemates WAL BUCK'S and Golden Point returned with good runner-up efforts last month and might fight this out, with a narrow vote going to the former.

  1. WAL BUCK'S (FR)
  2. GOLDEN POINT (FR)
  3. JAMESIECONN (IRE)

races.name: Fifty Shades Of Earl Grey Novices' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
RULE ME IN impressed at Newcastle and is selected to make light of a 7 lb rise, most likely at the expense of last month's C&D scorer Wearelongterm.

  1. RULE ME IN (IRE)
  2. WEARELONGTERM (IRE)
  3. JIRKO (FR)

races.name: luckytiger.co.uk Bet 20 Win 20 Wishing Well Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
None of the quartet can be ruled out but veteran KITTY'S LIGHT made a promising return from a long absence when an unlucky Fakenham fifth in May and gets the vote here off a handy-looking mark. Last year's victor Cadell could prove the chief danger ahead of Ki Woo.

  1. KITTY'S LIGHT
  2. CADELL (IRE)
  3. KI WOO (FR)

races.name: luckytiger.co.uk Best Odds Guaranteed The Night Before Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
HOURMAN looked an improved model when making an impressive winning reappearance at Hexham and with this return to a longer trip also a plus he gets a confident vote. Moon Over America returns from a year's absence but remains with potential and could emerge as the chief threat ahead of Pure Gold and last year's victor Heart Above.

  1. HOURMAN (FR)
  2. MOON OVER AMERICA (IRE)
  3. PURE GOLD

races.name: William Hill Epic Boosts EBF 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A promising quartet. Expensive point recruit STICK TO THE BOARD appeals as the most likely winner following his encouraging second at Chepstow. Worcester maiden winner Black Eddy and hurdling newcomer Old Coast Road both look interesting in their own right.

  1. STICK TO THE BOARD (IRE)
  2. BLACK EDDY
  3. OLD COAST ROAD (IRE)

races.name: William Hill Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The pick of KADASTRAL's novice hurdle form reads well (twice second behind one who finished runner-up in Grade 1 company) and having undergone a breathing operation following his Uttoxeter disappointment in the spring, Dan Skelton's 6-y-o firmly appeals as the type to do better now his attentions switch to larger obstacles. A pace duel won't help either C&D winner Sans Bruit or Javert Allen but both are too well handicapped to ignore. Conquer The Breeze is interesting at forecast longer odds.

  1. KADASTRAL (FR)
  2. SANS BRUIT (FR)
  3. JAVERT ALLEN (FR)

races.name: William Hill Molyneux Hurdle (Grade 2) (Formerly Registered As The Elite Hurdle) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Successful on 2 of his first 3 starts over hurdles (excuses when second here latterly), MYDADDYPADDY found further progress and shaped a shade better than the result too when an excellent third in the Supreme at Cheltenham in March. A notably nimble jumper, he remains open to improvement and is fancied to make a winning return. Alexei did nothing but improve throughout 2025/26, including when making the frame in Grade 1s on his final 2 starts and comfortably rates the lead threat.

  1. MYDADDYPADDY (IRE)
  2. ALEXEI (GER)
  3. MANGE TOUT (FR)

races.name: Boodles Rising Stars Novices' Chase (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Preference is for TALK TO THE MAN, who bettered his hurdles form at the first attempt sent chasing when winning a Worcester maiden in good style last month. He looks set to go on to better things over fences and can see off the challenge of No Drama This End, whose yard has a fine record in this race. Taurus Bay also appeals as the type to make a chaser and could be in the mix.

  1. TALK TO THE MAN (IRE)
  2. NO DRAMA THIS END (IRE)
  3. TAURUS BAY (IRE)

races.name: Pertemps Network Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Several will have later-season targets in mind, and the vote goes to OUR GUIDE, who finished third in a strong renewal of Silver Trophy last month. Heather Honey is also fancied to go well with a run under her belt, while Lihyan needs a second look at bigger prices. Harbour Lake, Kikijo and Red Risk have all gone well fresh previously.

  1. OUR GUIDE (IRE)
  2. HEATHER HONEY
  3. LIHYAN (IRE)

races.name: Play Lucky Stable With William Hill Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BOOMBAWN ended last season in better heart than his form figures would suggest and, having shaped well on return over hurdles at Chepstow 4 weeks ago, Dan Skelton's charge could well be ready to exploit his reduced chase mark with first-time cheekpieces enlisted. Knight of Allen often shaped well himself last season and is another on the shortlist, with C&D winner Imperial Saint and Southoftheborder completing the shortlist.

  1. BOOMBAWN (IRE)
  2. KNIGHT OF ALLEN (FR)
  3. IMPERIAL SAINT (FR)

races.name: William Hill Extra Places Every Day 'Junior' NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Little experience to go on, the vote going to AL CAPONY whose half-brother came to hand early in France as he won his first 2 starts over hurdles as a 3-y-o. Will Adam represents a yard which continues to go well and is next on the list, ahead of Nelouba who is the only one in the line-up with the benefit of a previous run.

  1. AL CAPONY (FR)
  2. WILL ADAM (IRE)
  3. NELOUBA (FR)

races.name: Matchbook Signup Get 20% Back On Losses Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
LUNAR TRIX created a fine impression when scoring here last month and may prove too strong for fellow course winner Chicker. Sea Tempest and Clondaw Buster appeal most of the hurdling debutants.

  1. LUNAR TRIX (IRE)
  2. CHICKER
  3. SEA TEMPEST (IRE)

races.name: Matchbook Betting Exchange Supporting UK Racing Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Decent claims can be made for all 4 with slight preference for the 2 chasing debutants, TOP JIMMY edging the vote.

  1. TOP JIMMY
  2. CINQUENTA (FR)
  3. DESERTMORE NEWS (IRE)

races.name: Follow Matchbook On X Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SENATOR was well on top at the finish when making a winning chase bow/return at Stratford 3 weeks ago so he's taken to defy a 7 lb rise. This does look competitive, though, with Moyganny Phil and Parliamo heading the dangers.

  1. SENATOR (FR)
  2. MOYGANNY PHIL (IRE)
  3. PARLIAMO (IRE)

races.name: Bet 20 Get 40 In Free Bets At matchbook.com Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Progressive HARBOUR LIGHT is fancied to make it a 4-timer. Pigeon Forge and Diamond Geezer appeal as the most likely dangers.

  1. HARBOUR LIGHT
  2. PIGEON FORGE (IRE)
  3. DIAMOND GEEZER (IRE)

races.name: Matchbook Loves Racing Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MOLTO BENE developed a positive profile over fences in 2025/26, only just denied a third win of the campaign at Market Rasen in April, and having scored first time out the last 2 seasons she could be ready to add to her tally. King's Threshold is next on the list having had an excuse when last seen, ahead of Aboutdamntime.

  1. MOLTO BENE (IRE)
  2. KING'S THRESHOLD (IRE)
  3. ABOUTDAMNTIME (IRE)

races.name: 0% Commission For 110 Days At Matchbook Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
With Sean Bowen back aboard and first-time cheekpieces added, AMBERELLI may be able to capitalise on a lowly mark. October Hill and Yeld To Call also appeal in a very tricky handicap.

  1. AMBERELLI
  2. OCTOBER HILL (IRE)
  3. YELD TO CALL (FR)

races.name: Download The Matchbook App Mares' Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
WISE MAIDEN made a winning Rules debut in good style in an Aintree bumper in May, travelling strongly before going on to score by 9½ lengths, and she can pick up where she left off to defy a penalty. Point winner Chicks For Free has joined a yard amongst the winners and isn't taken lightly, with Mariah's Dream completing the shortlist.

  1. WISE MAIDEN
  2. CHICKS FOR FREE (IRE)
  3. MARIAH'S DREAM

races.name: Virgin Bet Training Series Final Apprentice Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
FEEL THE NEED wasted no time getting back on the up when second over C&D 2 weeks ago and he'll surely go very close again from 1 lb higher. A well-run 7f on soft ground suits Stanage so he's second choice, ahead of Ghisa.

  1. FEEL THE NEED
  2. STANAGE
  3. GHISA (IRE)

races.name: Virgin Bet Training Series Final Apprentice Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
This looks wide open. BEAUTY CHOICE did well to overcome traffic problems when going in at Redcar recently and is taken to defy a 3 lb higher mark at the chief expense of Golden Strike who bids for a fourth victory of 2026 on the back of his latest York success. Last year's victor Lir Speciale can also have a big say too if shrugging off a lesser effort here last time. King's School completes the shortlist.

  1. BEAUTY CHOICE
  2. GOLDEN STRIKE (IRE)
  3. LIR SPECIALE (IRE)

races.name: Virgin Bet Cock O'The North EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CALA VADELLA's debut second at Leicester was full of promise and unless there is a useful newcomer lurking, she can go one place better. Virago Parvenue's sales prices increased slightly this year and she could be the threat unless the market speaks in favour of another debutant.

  1. CALA VADELLA
  2. VIRAGO PARVENUE (IRE)
  3. HOT MOONSTONE (FR)

races.name: Virgin Bet Supports Safer Gambling Nursery
races.verdict:
A combination of 7f and heavy ground may have just been too much of a test for RESEMBLANCE at Haydock last time but it was by no means a bad effort in third. She can quickly regain the winning thread, perhaps at the chief expense of the likeable Bladey Lady and My Boo Boo.

  1. RESEMBLANCE (IRE)
  2. BLADEY LADY (IRE)
  3. MY BOO BOO

races.name: Virgin Bet Every Saturday Money Back Wentworth Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
COUL ANGEL steps up in grade but there has been a lot to like about his recent big-field handicap victories at the Curragh and York (form of both been well advertised) and he looks very much the way to go. Copacabana Sands could emerge as the main threat if, as expected, building on a recent sixth in the Sceptre Stakes here, while Pellitory and Zen Diva can also have a say. Unique Journey completes the shortlist.

  1. COUL ANGEL (IRE)
  2. COPACABANA SANDS (IRE)
  3. PELLITORY

races.name: Virgin Bet Daily Price Boosts Irish EBF Gillies Fillies' Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Listed)
races.verdict:
It's fair to say I'M THE ONE hasn't lived up to expectations so far after her wide-margin debut win but she still sets the standard on her Cheshire Oaks form and testing conditions could well bring out the best in her (dam Group 1 winner in the mud). Felicitas looks the main threat back down in class, while Prosperity and Wadooda are both progressive.

  1. I'M THE ONE
  2. FELICITAS
  3. PROSPERITY

races.name: Virgin Bet November Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
The exciting ALFRED WINCHAM had so much in hand at York that even a 13 lb hike doesn't look enough to stop him. 2024 winner Lord Melbourne looks to have been targeted at this again and is feared most on the back of an encouraging run at York last month. Castle Cove has been absent since winning this last year but his good record fresh means it would come as no surprise were he to go well again. The reliable Say What You See should also have a say, while Nobody Knows is the unexposed one.

  1. ALFRED WINCHAM (IRE)
  2. LORD MELBOURNE (IRE)
  3. CASTLE COVE (IRE)

races.name: Virgin Bet Daily Extra Places Handicap
races.verdict:
Preference in the finale is for CRESTOFDISTINCTION, who took a step back in the right direction when runner-up at Goodwood last time on only his fourth start of the campaign. He can build on that effort to get back to winning ways, though Brighton Boy isn't taken lightly in his current form. Uncle Don and Rousing Encore complete the shortlist.

  1. CRESTOFDISTINCTION
  2. BRIGHTON BOY (IRE)
  3. UNCLE DON

races.name: All-Weather Championship Is Back Handicap
races.verdict:
KEATS HOUSE has responded well to the blinkers and is taken to resume winning ways with Rhys Elliott taking a handy 5 lb off. Titainium will be a threat if able to build on his latest back-to-form fourth at Newcastle. Billy Loughnane's mount Burford Beauty is next on the list ahead of Good Karma, who can play a part if his stamina holds back up at a 1m.

  1. KEATS HOUSE (IRE)
  2. TITAINIUM
  3. BURFORD BEAUTY (IRE)

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
This has the look of an interesting novice and it will probably go to a newcomer, with DEPUTY GENERAL and Highland Ranger arguably the most appealing pair before betting clues. Twice-raced Ring of Music surely has a race like this in him and won't be far away.

  1. DEPUTY GENERAL (USA)
  2. HIGHLAND RANGER
  3. RING OF MUSIC (IRE)

races.name: Midnite Building The Future Of Betting Handicap
races.verdict:
Ollie Sangster 3-y-o RIDGER makes obvious appeal under Billy Loughnane. Crown The Future is in a good vein of form and will be a threat if Charlie Tucker can get him into a good position from stall 12. Teggy Lasso would also need considering if the betting vibes are strong starting out for Mick Appleby and the Horse Watchers.

  1. RIDGER (IRE)
  2. CROWN THE FUTURE (IRE)
  3. TEGGY LASSO (IRE)

races.name: ARC All Weather Bonus Is Back EBF 'Confined' Restricted Maiden Stakes
races.verdict:
PALMS OASIS gets the nod to make it third time lucky over C&D for the Roger Varian yard. Chapel Down will be a threat if back to the form he showed on his all-weather debut. Al Alami is open to improvement on the back of an encouraging opening run at Kempton. Bondy Boy was prominent in the betting on his intended debut at the abandoned meeting here last Saturday and it'll be interesting to see if his supporters return.

  1. PALMS OASIS
  2. CHAPEL DOWN
  3. AL ALAMI

races.name: Midnight A Next Generation Betting App Handicap
races.verdict:
DRISH SAMPHIRE has upped her game since the hood was removed, winning twice in her last 3 starts, including a competitive handicap at Nottingham last month where she led close home. Despite being up 3 lb, she's fancied to follow up if proving as effective on all-weather. Up The Anti has returned to form with consecutive seconds but needs things to drop right, while Masai Angel is less exposed than most of these and could go well.

  1. DRISH SAMPHIRE (IRE)
  2. UP THE ANTI (IRE)
  3. MASAI ANGEL (FR)

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BUTTERFLY BEACH hasn't been seen since disappointing on reappearance in May but starts out for a new yard here and if she gets back to her juvenile form she'll be tough to beat. Nando Tornado showed ability along with inexperience on debut here 12 days ago and can improve, while March of Time holds claims in a race lacking in depth.

  1. BUTTERFLY BEACH (IRE)
  2. NANDO TORNADO (IRE)
  3. MARCH OF TIME (IRE)

races.name: Create Your Bet Builders At Midnite Handicap
races.verdict:
BONA FORTUNA has taken really well to all-weather on his last 2 starts and he looks sure to make a bold bid to resume winning ways. He's thereore selected to prove too good for Leading Times, who is 2 from 2 at this course, and Master of My Fate who is very well treated if fit enough after a break.

  1. BONA FORTUNA (IRE)
  2. LEADING TIMES
  3. MASTER OF MY FATE (IRE)

races.name: Midnite Built Different Handicap
races.verdict:
MASEGO was beaten 9 lengths by Clipsham Noble last time but still shaped well up with a strong pace on stable debut so could well reverse the form given his rival is a quirky sort prone to a bad start. Sahm Naif needs to prove his stamina but has a little more potential than most of these.

  1. MASEGO (IRE)
  2. CLIPSHAM NOBLE (IRE)
  3. SAHM NAIF (IRE)

races.name: Join The Midnite Movement Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
JUNKYARD DOG can make amends for a near miss at Newcastle last month with Cara Tuke taking a useful 7 lb off. Fram Castle and Sycamore Gap are closely matched on recent efforts over 1¾m here and head the dangers along with Jack Langley.

  1. JUNKYARD DOG (IRE)
  2. FRAM CASTLE (IRE)
  3. SYCAMORE GAP

meeting_summary.going: Hurdle: good to yielding; chase: good

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
Runner-up in a Grade 2 novice hurdle at Cheltenham last year, SIXANDAHALF couldn't make the most of a good opportunity sent chasing at Sligo on her return, but with that outing behind her she is fancied to do much better this time round. The biggest threat could come from Miss Fourie, who looked set to win last time before nearly unseating late on.

  1. SIXANDAHALF (IRE)
  2. MISS FOURIE (IRE)
  3. MO GHILLE MAR (IRE)

races.name: Gerry Comerford Drilling Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
This could go to one of the chasing debutants, with PRINCESS AVEEN preferred after showing sound form in points and winning over hurdles at Fairyhouse in October. Clody Diamond is open to improvement on her second start in this discipline so is on the shortlist along with Market Ready.

  1. PRINCESS AVEEN (IRE)
  2. CLODY DIAMOND (IRE)
  3. MARKET READY (IRE)

races.name: Noreside Catering Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
Making her handicap chase debut, BREAK MY SOUL produced her best effort over fences when third in the Grand Annual at Cheltenham and, with a good record fresh, she is taken to add to her C&D victory a year ago. Golden Joy was a good second at Leopardstown in February and is feared most for his new yard.

  1. BREAK MY SOUL (IRE)
  2. GOLDEN JOY (FR)
  3. LEAVE IN SECRET (IRE)

races.name: PRL Group Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
BRADY HARTSFIELD and Huntin Boots stand out on bumper form. John McConnell's charge is preferred given the antics of the latter on his hurdling debut, while Loadstone could be the pick of the Joseph O'Brien newcomers. Baila Conmigo and Rocky Alfonso complete the shortlist.

  1. BRADY HARTSFIELD (IRE)
  2. HUNTIN BOOTS (IRE)
  3. LOADSTONE (IRE)

races.name: Proficient Engineering Irish EBF Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
RECKLESS is likely the one to beat if reproducing his Fairyhouse effort on return. Hurdling debutant Got The Honours has some solid-looking point form, and he rates as the main danger.

  1. RECKLESS (FR)
  2. GOT THE HONOURS (IRE)
  3. LYRICAL PARK (IRE)

races.name: GAIN Equine Nutrition Novice Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
KOME DANS UN REVE has found some progression on his last 2 starts, staying on well to open his account at Limerick, and with the run of this race promising to suit he can score again now that he's up and running. Firebrand arrives on the back of a career best effort and is next on the list, ahead of Papagei.

  1. KOME DANS UN REVE (FR)
  2. FIREBRAND (GER)
  3. PAPAGEI

races.name: Pat Carroll's Pub Kilkenny Mares Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
Not as competitive as the numbers suggest and it could pay to side with KATE KNOWS BEST who should strip sharper for her recent Sligo fifth after an absence and can now capitalise on a handy-looking mark. A Snow White Park completed a hat-trick over fences at Clonmel two days ago and rates a major threat if translating that form back to hurdles. In-form maiden Demanding Gerry and the lightly-raced Lady Fromentro appeal as the pick of the rest.

  1. KATE KNOWS BEST (IRE)
  2. A SNOW WHITE PARK (IRE)
  3. DEMANDING GERRY (IRE)

races.name: Pat Carroll's Pub Kilkenny Mares Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
POETIC FOCUS looks to have plenty going for her and can gain compensation for a near miss at Clonmel last time. Eaglewood, Talas Kera and Frontier Rose are likely dangers in a competitive handicap.

  1. POETIC FOCUS (IRE)
  2. EAGLEWOOD (IRE)
  3. TALAS KERA (IRE)

Prix De L'operation Epsom Handicap - Awt
Prix De L'operation Martlet Handicap - Awt
Prix De L'operation Spring Handicap - Awt
Prix De L'operation Windsor Handicap - Awt
